headline: BMW Accelerates Job Cuts Amid Third-Quarter Profit Drop in China
summary: BMW announced it will step up planned job cuts after reporting a drop in third-quarter profit, driven by intense competition and falling demand in China.
why: BMW is a major global automobile manufacturer heavily exposed to the Chinese market, making local demand trends critical for its earnings.

impacts.name: BMW
impacts.why: Lower third-quarter profit and accelerated job cuts negatively affect the company's financial outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower profits and weaker demand in China directly weigh on automotive sector equities.
